insights: **Weekly Highlights —** RationAle Brewing grew total sales to $4,672 in Week 46, up 15.0% from $4,063 the prior week, on 292 units. Organic sales led the gain at $3,106 (+27.6% WoW), and the Mexican Cerveza 6-Pack broke out at $1,012 (+174.9%) on 87 units with a 41.8% conversion rate. The Hazy IPA 6-Pack ($556, +27.3%) and Kolsch 6-Pack ($388, +27.5%) also grew, and Sunday, Nov 8 was the peak day at $750.

**Metrics to Watch —** The Variety Pack remains the top seller at $1,916 (-4.9%) with sessions down 13.8% to 274, while its conversion improved to 25.5%. The West Coast IPA 6-Pack eased to $439 (-18.5%). Midweek was the softest stretch, with Wednesday, Nov 11 at $516, so we will focus on lifting traffic to the Variety Pack and keeping weekday sales steady.

**Ad Spend Efficiency —** Ad spend of $1,310 generated $1,565 in PPC revenue for a 1.19x ROAS (prior 1.43x) and 83.7% ACOS, with TACoS at 28.1%. Ad conversion is solid at 17.04% on a 0.38% ad CTR, so the opportunity is to trim spend on low-converting terms and shift it toward the products that are converting best.

**Actions This Week —** We will move budget toward the Mexican Cerveza 6-Pack to build on its +174.9% week, add search-term harvesting and negatives to bring ACOS down from 83.7%, and test fresh Sponsored Brand ad creative to lift ad CTR above 0.38%. We will also support the Variety Pack with targeted campaigns to rebuild sessions heading into the holiday season.
